welcome.title: Welcome!
welcome.text-body: Welcome to my website! This website is far from complete at this point, but it will be updated regularly. Here you can find information about me, my background, my projects, and more. Use the buttons in the top bar to navigate. You can also find relevant links here.

text-body.intro: As mentioned, the website is far from complete, so there are still some shortcomings and issues. In addition, there are features that I haven’t had a chance to implement yet. Below is a non-exhaustive list of these:

items.listItemBody: The elements on the page do not adapt perfectly to certain screen sizes. As a result, the page is also not optimized for viewing on smartphones or tablets.
The blog lacks certain features such as filters and search.
The design is not fully polished and will change gradually in the future. An example of this is the language menu, which currently does not look exactly as I would like.
In the future, I want the site to automatically set the language to the one your browser uses.

profile.profile-text-body: I hold a Master’s degree in Information Technology with solid experience in full-stack development and a specialization in artificial intelligence. I am passionate about artificial intelligence and software development, as well as how these fields can be used to create real social value. Personally, I thrive in interdisciplinary teams that offer autonomy and the opportunity to shape projects from concept to execution.

items.listItemBody: Implemented integrations with existing health platforms.
Implemented a cross-platform notifications with Firebase Cloud Messaging.
Designed and implemented the GraphQL API layer, schemas, efficient server-side resolvers, and optimized client-side queries for performance.
Implemented new features from initial concept and database design through to implementation.
Built and maintained responsive user interfaces using React and TypeScript.
Utilized Azure DevOps to track sprint progress, manage backlogs, and ensure timely delivery of assigned tasks.
Learned a great deal about data security as well as how these concepts are used to protect data in networks. Examples of this involve encryption, network protocols, the OSI data model.

Took many courses in artificial intelligence and completed my master's degree with a project centered on reinforcement learning. Learned about deep learning, neural networks, machine learning, Bayesian machine learning, computer vision, and more.

Learned to work almost completely unsupervised and autonomously for a complete semester under the supervision of Nina Gierasimczuk, an associate professor at DTU. Implemented and augmented a reinforcement learning algorithm with logic tensor networks. For more information, refer to the projects section.
Learned to program in various languages (e.g., Java, C, and F#). Also learned a great deal about object-oriented and functional Programming.
Learned about varius essential software tools such as Git, GitHub, code editors, and IDEs.
Learned about CPUs, compilers, assembly, machine code instructions, and how computers work at the fundamental level.
Worked in many projects, most of them involving programming, and learned to efficiently collaborate with others using software tools.
Learned about essential algorithms and data structures, as well as how to analyze them.

items.title: Personal website
items.text-body: Developed a personal website using the following tech stack: React, TypeScript, Vite, Prisma, Redux, Tailwind. The code resides in a public repo on my GitHub page.

items.title: Master's thesis
items.text-body: Implemented the MADDPG reinforcement learning algorithm and logic tensor networks in Python. Several machine learning libraries were used: PyTorch, PettingZoo, Gymnasium, etc.

items.title: Multi-agent systems
items.text-body: Implemented collaborative, intelligent agents in Java at my university. My team won an award for a top-10 finish in the final competition.

items.title: Android app
items.text-body: Created an Android app during my studies with Java and Kotlin. Component development and prototyping was performed in Figma.

items.title: Bodybuilding
items.text-body: I regularly lift weights to keep myself in a healthy condition.

items.title: Running
items.text-body: Running soothes my mind whenever life throws obstacles my way. I also commit myself to the activity to keep my body in a healthy condition.

items.title: Notetaking
items.text-body: I have made it a hobby to take notes whenever I read and learn about important and interesting subjects. I considure it a leisurely activity and am passionate about designing my notes such that they capture the fundamentals of whatever I learn.

items.title: Artifical intelligence
items.text-body: I am very passionate about artificial intelligence, especially reinforcement learning, and neuro-symbolic artificial intelligence. I like to learn about related subjects in my free time whenever time permits.
